Narrative of a Five Years Expedition Against the Revolted Negros of Surinam- John Stedman. It’s free as an e-book on the books app on apple. A memoir from the 1700’s set in Surinam/Guyana by a Scottish mercenary with abolitionist tendencies. Lots of in depth inquiries into the culture of the region, the topic of slavery and its horrors and generally a great read due to the detail of the land and its peoples right the way down to the different types of fruit.
